name: Governed Analytics Assistant
description: NL -> SQL/DAX/KQL assistant that answers only from governed Fabric sources and respects semantic-model definitions.
schemaNote: Reference config for the Fabric Data Agent demo. Field names are illustrative; create the agent in the Fabric portal and transcribe these settings into the Instructions, data-source notes, and example queries.

dataSources.name: SalesLakehouse
dataSources.purpose: Row-level SQL access to the star schema.
dataSources.notes: Revenue is net of discount. Never compute revenue as ListPrice * Quantity.

dataSources.name: SalesSemanticModel
dataSources.purpose: Governed DAX measures and KPIs. Prefer this for any measure/KPI question.

guardrails.refusalMessage: That data isn't available in the connected sources, so I can't answer it.

exampleQueries.question: What was total revenue in 2025 and how did it grow vs 2024?
exampleQueries.query: EVALUATE ROW("Revenue 2025", CALCULATE([Total Revenue], DimDate[Year]=2025), "Revenue 2024", CALCULATE([Total Revenue], DimDate[Year]=2024), "YoY %", CALCULATE([Revenue YoY %], DimDate[Year]=2025))

exampleQueries.question: Show revenue and gross margin % by product category for 2025.
exampleQueries.query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(DimProduct[Category], FILTER(DimDate, DimDate[Year]=2025), "Revenue", [Total Revenue], "Margin %", [Gross Margin %]) ORDER BY [Revenue] DESC

exampleQueries.question: Top 5 customers by revenue in 2025.
exampleQueries.query: SELECT TOP 5 c.CustomerName, SUM(f.Revenue) AS Revenue FROM FactSales f JOIN DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey JOIN DimCustomer c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey WHERE d.Year = 2025 GROUP BY c.CustomerName ORDER BY Revenue DESC

exampleQueries.question: Monthly revenue trend for the Mobile category in 2025.
exampleQueries.query: SELECT d.MonthNumber, d.MonthName, SUM(f.Revenue) AS Revenue FROM FactSales f JOIN DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey WHERE d.Year = 2025 AND p.Category = 'Mobile' GROUP BY d.MonthNumber, d.MonthName ORDER BY d.MonthNumber

exampleQueries.question: Which region had the highest average discount in 2025?
exampleQueries.query: SELECT r.Region, AVG(f.Discount) AS AvgDiscount FROM FactSales f JOIN DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey JOIN DimRegion r ON f.RegionKey = r.RegionKey WHERE d.Year = 2025 GROUP BY r.Region ORDER BY AvgDiscount DESC
